{"metadata":{"description":"Exa Search MCP for DeepSeek Harness: mounts the remote Exa MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge","id":"gh:1333656562","install_available":true,"language":null,"name":"dsh-exa-mcp","slug":"MicroHEROX/dsh-exa-mcp","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Exa Search MCP for DeepSeek Harness: mounts the remote Exa MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) thr"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ough the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Exa Search MCP for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English ·
中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A third-party plugin that brings Exa — the neural web search and fetch engine — into DeepSeek Harnes"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s (`dsh`). It connects to Exa's hosted MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP) through the MCP client bridge "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"that ships with the `dsh` CLI, and registers Exa's tools as native agent tools under the `exa` names"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ships with the `dsh` CLI, and registers Exa's tools as native agent tools under the `exa` namespace."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Zero install footprint: no code runs in the dsh process — the upstream is Exa's official hosted en"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"dpoint.
- Pure configuration bundle: one patch layer, no build step, no runtime API.
- Never touches"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" your deepseek-harness installation; it only adds one row to the composed `cordis.yml`."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Quick Start"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### 1. Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Option A — install as a plugin bundle (recommended, requires pnpm):**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> **Verify after a `github:` install** — when the route to github.com is unstable, a `github:` (git)"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" install can silently fail or finish with an un-synced `dsh.profile.bundles` (local `link:`/`file:` "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"installs are unaffected). Verify and fix in one step:
>
[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":">
> The timing issue is reported upstream (Discussions #656); `--patch` overlays are never affected."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Option B — one-off overlay, no install:**"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Option C — keep it permanently without installing:** merge the single `insert` block from `cordis."},{"id":"p15s2","text":"patch.yml` into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` (or `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` for ev"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` (or `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` for every profile)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> Install behavior: pnpm installs git dependencies through the `files` field, so `docs/` is **not** "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"installed into your runtime — only `cordis.patch.yml` is. The docs live in this repository."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 2. Provide an Exa API key (optional)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The hosted endpoint works **anonymously** on Exa's free tier (rate-limited, basic tools only). To li"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ft limits and unlock advanced search / Exa Agent, create an API key and set it in the environment:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The plugin **auto-detects** the key at load time: `EXA_API_KEY` set → sends `x-api-key`; unset → ano"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"nymous. Never put the key into any patch file."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 3. Verify"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. Start `dsh web` (with the bundle or overlay applied).
2. Wait a moment for initial discovery (it "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"is asynchronous).
3. Ask: *"Use Exa to find the latest release notes of the DeepSeek Harness project"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" on GitHub and summarize them."*
4. Confirm the model called `mcp__exa__web_search_exa` (and `web_fe"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"tch_exa` for full text) and answered from the results."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## What This Plugin Does"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Connects `https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp` via `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (`streamable-http` transport),"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" the official bridge shipped with the dsh CLI.
- Registers every tool Exa advertises under the spec-"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"compliant name `mcp__exa__<tool>`; re-syncs automatically on `tools/list_changed` notifications.
- A"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"uto-authenticates: attaches `x-api-key` only when `EXA_API_KEY` is present (graceful anonymous fallb"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ack — no broken `undefined` header).
- Tunes the bridge for search workloads: `toolCallTimeoutMs: 18"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"0000` for long research tasks; reconnect policy left at bridge defaults.
- Follows dsh plugin conven"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"tions exactly: bundle manifest (`dsh.bundle.patch`), patch-layer composition, per-id override (`mcp-"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"exa`), `!!js` config expressions only."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## What This Plugin Does NOT Do"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Does **not** download, host, or supervise any Exa server — the upstream is Exa's hosted endpoint.
"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"- Does **not** implement OAuth login (`https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp?login`) — the dsh MCP bridge has no OA"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"uth flow; use an API key.
- Does **not** bridge MCP resources or prompts — the harness only consumes"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" MCP tools.
- Does **not** choose Exa plans, manage billing, or store your API key — the key lives i"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"n your environment only.
- Does **not** modify your deepseek-harness installation — installing/unins"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"talling only touches `$DSH_HOME/profiles/`."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Routes That Work"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Route | How |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Anonymous search + fetch | Do nothing — free tier, rate-limited, 2 tools |
| Full tool set (advanc"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ed search, Agent) | Set `EXA_API_KEY` + restart; whitelist Agent via `?tools=` (below) |
| Tool whit"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"elist / default search type | Override the `mcp-exa` row's `url` with `?tools=web_search_exa,web_fet"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ch_exa,agent_run` or `?defaultSearchType=fast` (see docs/API.md) |
| Multiple MCP servers | Add more"},{"id":"p29s5","text":" `mcp-client` rows with unique `serverName` values |
| Hot reload | Edit the row in a patch layer — "},{"id":"p29s6","text":"HMR reconnects without process restart |
| Uninstall | `dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-exa-m"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"cp` — profile and base bundles stay intact |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Routes That Do NOT Work (by design)"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Route | Why not |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| OAuth login flow | dsh mcp-client does not implement the OAuth handshake — use an API key |
| MCP "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"resources / prompts from Exa | The harness bridges tools only |

| DeepSeek Harness CLI (`@deepseek-ai/dsh"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"`) | **≥ 0.1.0-rc.5**, tested on **0.1.0-rc.8 / 0.1.1-rc.1** | The CLI ships the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-m"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"cp-client` bridge this bundle mounts |
| MCP bridge (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) | `^0.1.0-rc.8` "},{"id":"p35s4","text":"/ `^0.1.1-rc.1` (resolved from the dsh CLI) | No separate install needed |
| Exa MCP endpoint (`mcp."},{"id":"p35s5","text":"exa.ai/mcp`) | server **3.2.1** (probed 2026-08-14) | Exa-managed; may change without notice |
| MCP"},{"id":"p35s6","text":" protocol version | `2025-06-18` | Negotiated automatically |
| Node.js | tested on **v24.16.0**; No"},{"id":"p35s7","text":"de ≥ 22 recommended | dsh itself does not declare an `engines` range |
| Platform | Windows / macOS "},{"id":"p35s8","text":"/ Linux | Config-only bundle; no platform-specific code |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"dsh is in developer preview and iterates rapidly. After upgrading `dsh`, re-run the verification ste"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ps from docs/SOLUTIONS.md."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- The only secret involved is `EXA_API_KEY`, read from the environment at load time; it is sent to E"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"xa as the `x-api-key` header and never written to any file by this plugin.
- No third-party code exe"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"cutes inside the dsh process — the plugin is declarative configuration over the official bridge.
- T"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"his repository contains no keys, no local paths, and no machine-specific data."}],"truncated":true}
